connect.title: Konekte LinkedIn
connect.intro: Konekte avek kont LinkedIn ki zer ou bann piblisite. Leadrat lir zis ou bann kont piblisite, bann lead Lead Gen Form ek bann statistik piblisite, e avoy bann konversion ki ou finn alime.
connect.need1: Enn rol lor kont piblisite LinkedIn (Viewer ou pli ot).
connect.need2: Enn rol lor paz konpagni ki lie (Administrater, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator ou Analyst) - LinkedIn obliz li partaz bann lead.
connect.need3: Enn kestion lor nimero telefonn lor ou Lead Gen Forms - bann lead san enn nimero telefonn pa kapav azoute.

connection.title: Koneksion
connection.syncResult: Sinkronizasion finn fini: {{received}} finn resevwar, {{created}} finn kree, {{duplicates}} doub, {{rejected}} finn rezete.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Dekonekte LinkedIn ? Sinkronizasion arete ek bann jeton akse finn efase. Bann lead, statistik ek rezis aktivite garde.
connection.noPermission: Ou kapav get sa paz-la. Pou konekte ek sanz bann konfigirasion bizin permision "Zer bann konfigirasion".
connection.fetchHint: Bann nouvo lead verifie sak de-trwa minit e bann dernie 7 zour re-verifie toulezour, pou ki nanye pa rate. Servi sa pou bann lead avan ou konekte, ou pou verifie enn peryod ankor (ziska 90 zour alafwa). Bann lead ki deza dan Leadrat finn sote.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Dir LinkedIn kisannla parmi so bann lead finn vinn bann vre prospektif. Kan enn lead LinkedIn ariv enn stati ki ou finn swazir anba, Leadrat raport li a LinkedIn , pou ki ou bann rapor kanpagn montre kalite lead e LinkedIn kapav trouv plis dimounn kouma ou bann meyer lead. Zis ID lead LinkedIn ek enn hash one-way sa email-la ki finn avoye.
capi.noRules: Pena okenn stati ki finn map ankor.
capi.created: Konversion finn kree lor LinkedIn ek finn mape.
